methodology.description: Probabilistic scoring, not a trained/calibrated model -- see file header comment for full rationale and limitations.
knownLimitations: Cross-model agreement bonus only applies to list_entry claims (exact-name matching); freeform_sentence claims have no automated agreement signal since models phrase the same idea differently.

The fact-checker only covers ONE class of error (nitrogen-fixing misattribution against a 17-crop table) -- a 'clean' factCheckStatus means 'not caught by this specific check', not 'verified correct'.
No real-world outcome data exists to calibrate these scores against -- probability values are a ranking/triage tool, not a measured accuracy rate.
